description: Mathstral 7B is Mistral AI's mathematics-specialized 7B parameter model, built on Mistral 7B and optimized for mathematical and scientific reasoning tasks. It achieves competitive performance with larger models on math benchmarks.

trainingData.description: Fine-tuned from Mistral 7B on mathematical and scientific reasoning data.

trainingProcedure: Specialized fine-tuning on mathematical datasets and reasoning chains.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Strong mathematical reasoning capabilities. Competitive with larger models on competition mathematics benchmarks.

knownLimitations: Specialized for math - less capable at general tasks
7B parameters limits complex reasoning compared to larger models

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in mathematical training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Chat template support for safe interactions.
